:::{#def-cv-se}
#### Standard error of a cross-validation estimate

The **standard error** of a $k$-fold [cross-validation estimate](#def-cv-estimate)
is the [sample standard deviation](exploratory-descriptive.qmd#def-sample-sd)
of the $k$ [fold mean squared errors](#def-fold-mse),
divided by $\sqrt{k}$:

$$
\cvse \eqdef \frac{\hSD{\foldmse{1}, \ldots, \foldmse{k}}}{\sqrt{k}}.
$$ {#eq-cv-se}
